en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large two‑towered church building viewed from the street. The tall, plain towers have steep roofs and small arched windows. At the front is an ornate entrance portal with a round window above it, opening onto a town square with a few small figures. At the top in red Gothic-style print is the caption identifying the location and the church.
